about_the_game:
This is a short e-book documenting Circle TSUKIYAKI's process of creating The Seabed's Shining Star. Includes sketches, scrapped ideas, and all sorts of little stories about our creative process.

Contains spoilers for the novel, so only open it after you're done reading.

How to access:

After you purchase and download the DLC, you will find the .pdf file in the game's main directory.

In your Steam Library, right-click The Seabed's Shining Star, choose Manage, then select Browse Local Files.
